verdict.rationale: Twilio's docs describe a real-time feed of all Twilio events streamed to multiple destinations, though they never say webhooks are one of those destinations. A hands-on community user reports using Twilio for voicemail-to-webhook delivery, which corroborates outbound HTTP callbacks. missing for 10: first-party docs on registering webhook endpoints, the catalog of subscribable event types, a statement that event-stream destinations include HTTP webhooks, and delivery/retry/signature details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Get a unified, real-time feed of all Twilio events and interactions streamed to multiple destinations.
They still use Twilio for voicemail-to-webhook with transcription.
